evidence.caveat: Regulatory quarantine geography supports the named program condition, not broader abundance or county inventory. A quarantine can include buffer, movement-control, or administrative areas and is not a population survey. Snapshot silence never supports absence or non-detection.

evidence.sourceLabel: USDA APHIS northern giant hornet eradication statement (2024)
evidence.caveat: This is an explicit authoritative eradication determination, not an inference from silence, an empty query, a map, a model, or an unconfirmed survey result. The determination is current only through the parent record validThrough date and must fail closed after that date without reaffirmation.
